title: By 2035, BLS projects +{c[jb-002][value]} percent for data scientists and {c[jb-007][value]} for data entry keyers
subtitle: Projected percent change in employment, 2025 to 2035. BLS says it adjusts for AI conservatively, where there is convincing evidence for a change.
text: The Bureau of Labor Statistics' ten-year projection by occupation includes the trades that build data centers. The studies that have looked for AI's effect on employment so far disagree, and are shown together.
reading: {label}: {display} projected change, 2025 to 2035. BLS Employment Projections, {published}.

rows.label: Data scientists
rows.detail: From 275.6 thousand jobs in 2025 to 371.0 thousand in 2035.

rows.label: Power-line installers
rows.detail: All U.S. power-line installers and repairers; BLS does not limit this to data center load growth.

rows.detail: From 1717.8 thousand jobs in 2025 to 1892.6 thousand in 2035.

rows.label: Electricians
rows.detail: BLS expects about 72,700 openings a year, including replacements. BLS does not attribute this demand to data centers.
